text:
Alex Chen: Kickoff: Orion Retail onboarding goes live Mon 2026-04-06. Need final stakeholder list, explicit 14-day success criteria, and clear owners for infra / enablement / billing. Any known renewal flags we should track? @Marco Ruiz @Dana Lee @Priya Patel

Marco Ruiz: Quick list from intake: Lina Torres (Head Product), Omar Haddad (Infra), Jess Carter (Data Ops), and Finance lead TBD. Lina prefers Tue mornings. CSM flagged a budget check in ~45 days - medium risk.

Priya Patel: I can lead enablement (docs + 1-hr workshop). I'll draft a 60-min agenda by EOD. Preference: start with product flow & console basics, then integration patterns. Thoughts? :memo:

Dana Lee: I'll own technical onboarding: env, API creds, sample ingestion, smoke tests. Need network contact for Private deployment (firewall + IP allowlist). I'll post a pre-checklist tomorrow.

Alex Chen: Draft 14-day success criteria proposal: 1) Staging end-to-end smoke with median gen latency <200ms; 2) 10 representative prompts pass quality gates (<=5% hallucination); 3) Console accounts for 3 engineers; 4) Billing/quota validated and first cost estimate delivered. Add or edit?

Marco Ruiz: Add: pin initial model to rw-v1.3 to avoid surprise updates. Also require data handling signoff if prompt sets contain PII.

Priya Patel: +1. I'll schedule enablement for Wed 10:00am PT and share invites after agenda is posted. I'll include a 10-min troubleshooting playbook.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "Orion - Enablement" Wed 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC - https://calendar.example/evt/98765 :calendar:

Dana Lee: Pre-checklist items (draft): - Provide service account + API key - Provide IP allowlist entries - Upload sample payloads/schema - Grant console access for 3 engineers - Share test prompt set in shared drive

Sample quick test for engineers:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\ 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\ 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\ 
  -d '{\"model\":\"rw-v1.3\",\"prompt\":\"Hello world\",\"max_tokens\":64}'
```

Alex Chen: Who will own the 14-day health check doc (KPIs + blockers + renewal signal + next steps)? Need a one-pager and a short sync.

Marco Ruiz: I will own the 14-day health check. I'll draft the one-pager with owners and KPIs (latency p50/p95, error rate, quality pass rate, integration blockers) and have it ready by day 12.

Priya Patel: I'll run a 3-question feedback form during enablement and dump results into the playbook.

Alex Chen: Good. I'll update the onboarding playbook with owners and tasks. Cadence: enablement Wed, go/no-go Fri quick check. :thumbsup:

Marco Ruiz: Omar asked for an SLA exceptions note for initial limits. I'll add an SLA exceptions section and loop infra.

Dana Lee: Shared drive folder created and checklist uploaded: https://drive.example/folder/Orion-Onboard. I also added a links doc for firewall/infrastructure contacts.

Alex Chen: Final: add the 45-day budget review as a renewal risk in the Renewal Signals sheet and include mitigation (exec intro, usage highlights, weekly adoption report).
